title: 检查点 Runtime 组合层接入：离线端口适配、精确集成 diff 与故障矩阵
evidenceLevel: G1+ offline Runtime composition (real temporary ControlStore/SQLite/Session files; synthetic native-state/flush/projection/memory seams)

build.buildCommand: npm run check (tsc --noEmit + node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts + tsc -p tsconfig.build.json + node --check client/index.js)

integrationDiff.target: src/runtime.ts (Lead applies; this slice does not edit it)
preconditions: RuntimeOptions.checkpointStagingRoot is a trusted absolute path outside dataDir; otherwise the command returns CHECKPOINT_STAGING_UNCONFIGURED and never falls back to temp.
RuntimeOptions.checkpointRuntimeManifest is a trusted fixed host identity; the composition never guesses a host version from a request.
The command is dispatched before ensureCanRun() so a paused runtime can snapshot local state; it performs no model calls, dispatches nothing and does not change pause state.
Composition creation is lazy and happens only inside the explicit command; GET/snapshot/status paths never call it.
A failed attempt is returned as a structured failed/incomplete result and recorded in the diagnostic field; it is never retried automatically and never queued.
failureDegradation: Goal Session path/state/projection/flush unavailable → component explicitly unavailable → Bundle incomplete, never ready.
Managed Ombre export unavailable → memory component explicitly unavailable → Bundle incomplete, never ready.
Capture failure or staging interruption → structured failed/incomplete result; lastGood is not replaced.

boundaries.evidenceLevel: G1+ offline Runtime composition + synthetic Goal/memory seams
boundaries.h5B1ArtifactsHistorical: artifacts/dsh/h5/h5-recovery-matrix.json + h5-recovery-validator-selftest.json were generated for the H5-B1 submission (5a7bc9e) and are not rewritten by H5b; H5b additive schema fields are optional/backward compatible and this file records the current source/test fingerprints.
boundaries.v22Claim: sub-scenarios only; composition capture/restore on synthetic seams
boundaries.v27Claim: not attempted; requires an independent failure domain and offline recovery credentials

requiredScope: public read-only API that returns the exact durable log path for a native Session (the installed JSONL backend resolveCurrentLog is an internal diagnostic, not a provider-neutral contract)
public read-only native Goal state (GoalRef revision, phase, activation/armed) without creating or resuming an Agent
host durability barrier for the exact session (sessions.flush or an equivalent acknowledged flush)
exportable projection definition + configuration digest for the log format, or an approved offline projection/export adapter
a host-supported offline-decodable log format: plain JSONL, or a public read/decompress API (default zstd frames are not independently verifiable offline)
an approved public export/archive API for the managed Ombre memory backend that returns a component manifest, reference closure and deletion state
or an approved offline export adapter with the same manifest/hash/closure semantics, without writing the live managed vault
